plans.buy_case: OXY is setting up a textbook Bollinger Band squeeze breakout with confirming MACD histogram reversal and bullish RSI divergence — price made a lower low while RSI held higher, signaling underlying buying pressure. The golden cross (50MA well above 200MA) and price trading 25% above the 200MA confirm the broader uptrend is intact. With Buffett's position as a sentiment floor and above-average volume validating the move, this has the ingredients of a momentum-driven swing to the upside.
plans.entry_condition: Enter on a confirmed BB squeeze breakout — wait for price to close above $60.50 on volume ≥ 1.2x average, confirming the squeeze is resolving to the upside. Do NOT chase intraday; require a daily close above that level before entering.
plans.exit_condition: Exit at $66.50 (upper BB target / ~10% gain), or exit immediately if price closes below the 50MA (~$58.47), which would invalidate the breakout thesis. Also exit if RSI exceeds 72 before target — don't overstay a momentum move.
plans.risk: OXY is highly leveraged to WTI crude — if oil slides below $70/bbl on demand fears or a macro risk-off event, this trade breaks down fast regardless of technicals. The RSI at 55.6 is mid-range, not oversold, so this is a breakout play not a mean-reversion entry — requires the squeeze to actually fire. Position size ($1,133 / ~32% of portfolio) is aggressive; consider halving to ~$550 if oil macro feels uncertain.

plans.buy_case: MGM is flashing a textbook oversold setup — RSI at 24 with price hugging the lower Bollinger Band while still trading above the 200MA ($35.60), which confirms the broader uptrend is intact. The MACD histogram turning up from a valley suggests selling momentum is exhausting, and a mean-reversion bounce toward the mid-BB is a high-probability play in this environment. With a golden cross in place and volume confirming the move, the technical case for a short-term recovery is solid even if the fundamental story is murky.
plans.entry_condition: Enter at market open or on any intraday dip toward $36.50–$36.80, ideally on a green candle confirming the MACD histogram uptick. Do not chase if price gaps up more than 2% before you can enter.
plans.exit_condition: Exit when RSI approaches 55–60, price touches the middle or upper Bollinger Band (~$40–$41), or if MACD crosses back negative. Hard stop-loss at $34.80 (just below the 200MA), which limits downside to roughly 5.3%.
plans.risk: The biggest risk is macro deterioration or a weak consumer spending print that hammers cyclicals broadly — MGM's elevated debt load means it sells off harder than the market in risk-off moves. A breakdown below the 200MA ($35.60) would invalidate the entire thesis and require an immediate cut.

plans.buy_case: CVX is flashing a compelling technical setup: a Bollinger Band squeeze is coiling for a directional move, MACD histogram is turning up from a valley, and bullish RSI divergence confirms underlying buying pressure despite the recent price pullback. The stock is well above its 200MA with a golden cross intact, meaning you're trading with the long-term trend. For a quality integrated major with disciplined capital returns, this is a reasonable swing entry point.
plans.entry_condition: Enter on a limit order at or below $191.50 if price holds above the 200MA and MACD histogram continues to tick upward on the next 1-2 daily candles. Do not chase above $193 (50MA resistance) — wait for the squeeze to break with confirmation rather than buying into overhead resistance.
plans.exit_condition: Take profit near $202 (approx. 5-6% gain, upper Bollinger Band target post-squeeze expansion). Cut the position if price closes below $185.50 (below recent price low of $181.62 structure support with buffer), or if RSI rolls over below 45 before the target is reached. Also exit if MACD histogram reverses back negative.
plans.risk: The Hess acquisition uncertainty is the primary fundamental wildcard — any adverse ruling or deal collapse could gap CVX down sharply. Technically, the 50MA at $193.05 is sitting just above current price and could act as stubborn resistance, stalling the squeeze breakout. Commodity price softness (oil below $75) would also undermine the trade thesis.

plans.buy_case: KIM is flashing a textbook mean-reversion setup: RSI at 28.8 (deep oversold), price hugging the lower Bollinger Band with a squeeze active, and the golden cross confirms the longer-term uptrend is intact with price well above the 200MA. As a grocery-anchored REIT with solid fundamentals, this is the kind of quality name that tends to snap back cleanly from oversold conditions rather than continue deteriorating. The BB squeeze adds a volatility expansion catalyst that could accelerate the rebound.
plans.entry_condition: Enter at market open or on any intraday dip toward $22.75–$23.00. Ideally wait for a green candle confirmation off the lower BB — do not chase if price gaps up more than 1.5% above current levels before you can act.
plans.exit_condition: Exit when RSI reclaims 55–60 and/or price touches the upper Bollinger Band. Also exit if the 50MA crosses back below the 200MA or price closes more than 2 sessions below $22.00 on elevated volume — that invalidates the setup.
plans.risk: Interest rate sensitivity is the primary headwind — any hawkish Fed surprise or spike in the 10-year yield will pressure all REITs regardless of technicals. The BB squeeze could also resolve to the downside if macro sentiment deteriorates, so the stop at $22.00 is non-negotiable.

plans.buy_case: SBAC is flashing a textbook mean-reversion setup: RSI at 27 in oversold territory, price hugging the lower Bollinger Band with a squeeze active, and critically, price is holding above the 200MA with a golden cross already in place — that structural support makes this a higher-quality dip-buy than most. Tower REITs have sticky, contracted cash flows and 5G densification is a multi-year secular tailwind that doesn't evaporate in a few weeks, giving this trade a fundamental backstop. The elevated volume on the selloff (1.14x) suggests the flush may be exhausting rather than accelerating.
plans.entry_condition: Enter at market open or on any intraday dip toward $197-$199. Do not chase above $202. Ideally confirm with a daily candle that closes green or shows a hammer/doji reversal off the lower BB.
plans.exit_condition: Exit when RSI reclaims 55-60, price tags the middle Bollinger Band (~$207) or upper band (~$213), or if price closes decisively below the 200MA ($196.52) on elevated volume — that invalidates the setup immediately.
plans.risk: Rate sensitivity is the primary threat — any hawkish Fed commentary or a spike in the 10-year Treasury yield above 4.5% will hammer REITs regardless of technicals. The elevated debt load amplifies this sensitivity, and if price breaks the 200MA convincingly, this trade fails structurally.
